description: Delete one custom eBay Store category (Stores API deleteStoreCategory). Pass the store categoryId and optionally listingDestinationCategoryId; active listings in or under the category move there, or to the store's Other category (ID 1) when omitted. Irreversible. Asynchronous: eBay accepts the change and returns { taskId, location } from the Location header; poll ebay_get_store_task with taskId (or ebay_get_store_tasks) until the task is COMPLETED or FAILED. Only one store category change (add, rename, move, or delete) can be in flight at a time; eBay rejects a new change until the previous task finishes. Requires an active eBay Store subscription (sell.stores scope).

categoryId.description: eBay Store custom category ID from ebay_get_store_categories (not an eBay marketplace category ID)

listingDestinationCategoryId.description: Store category that receives active listings in or under the deleted category; omitted, eBay uses the Other category (ID 1)

name: ebay_delete_store_category
